reason: The requested feature is implemented and consistent across the frontend and backend. web/index.html provides a Pay now button (#pay) and a live result region (#result). web/app.js wires the button click to POST {cart, method:'card'} to /api/checkout, renders success from amount_cents/100, status and method, and renders errors from the server error field; the button is disabled only while a request is in flight. checkout_app/server.py serves /api/checkout via do_POST, parses the cart and method, calls create_checkout, and returns 400 {error} on KeyError/ValueError/TypeError/JSONDecodeError. checkout_app/checkout.py validates the cart and method and returns {status:'pending_payment', amount_cents, method}, matching the client's expected response shape. run.py launches the current server unless CHECKOUT_COMPAT=on, preserving the existing flow. The unit test test_checkout.py confirms the contract for a valid cart and an empty-cart error. No causal defect is evidenced in the read artifacts; the noted non-blocking follow-ups (placeholder cart, no idempotency, no telemetry) are pre-GA enhancements, not defects in the requested feature.
